name: Miro
label: Miro REST API
description: Miro REST API via OfficialApiNode (nodes/miro/api_spec.json). Official Miro REST v2. App review for production OAuth. Board export may be restricted. Official docs: https://developers.miro.com/reference/api-reference. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Miro official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"board_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'board_create', 'board_get', 'board_update', 'board_copy', 'board_list', 'item_create_shape', 'item_get', 'item_list', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'board_create'.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Board name for board_create / board_update / board_copy. Example: Sprint board.

schema.label: board_id
schema.description: Miro board id for board_* and item_*. Example: uXjVPxxxx=

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size for board_list and item_list. Positive integer, max 50. Example: 20.

schema.label: item_id
schema.description: Board item id for item_get. Example: 3458764512345678901.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: item_list pagination cursor from a previous response.

schema.label: Copy From
schema.description: Source board id for board_copy (PUT /boards?copy_from=<id>). Example: 'uXjVOabc'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: board_create, board_get, board_update, board_copy, board_list, item_create_shape, item_get, item_list, listen. Default: board_create. Example: board_create.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Copy From
configurationParameters.description: Source board id for board_copy (PUT /boards?copy_from=<id>). Example: 'uXjVOabc'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
